claims_and_limits: The November 4 release fixes credential resolution for node parameter loading and named array-key reads in expressions.
An isolated expression returning the whole array can still lose its named keys; that behavior is outside the cited fix.
Archived workflows remain scanned and filterable, though omitted from default migration-report totals; the release is not a security advisory.
